meaning:
A woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.15.2; married to Amaziah (H0558);
mother of: Uzziah (H5818)
§ Jecoliah or Jecholiah = "Jehovah is able"
wife of king Amaziah of Judah and mother of king Uzziah (Azariah)

elsewhere.note: He was sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.
Uzziah was sixteen years old when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jechiliah, of Jerusalem.
